lines.beaver: 지훈 씨, 카메라가 왜 안 켜져요?
lines.beaver_en: Jihun, why won't the camera turn on?
lines.beaver_roman: Jihun ssi, kameraga wae an kyeojyeoyo?
lines.en: The battery's dead. I should have charged it yesterday.

lines.beaver_en: The battery was dead? What about the spare?
lines.learner: 그것도 집에 있어요. 챙겨 올걸 그랬어요.
lines.en: That's at home too. I should have brought it.
lines.roman: Geugeotdo jibe isseoyo. Chaenggyeo olgeol geuraesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then let's plug it into the power and shoot.
Did you tell the station? We'll be running late.
lines.en: Not yet. I'll log in to the network's site first.

lines.beaver_en: Did you post a notice on the board too?
lines.learner: 아, 홈페이지 게시판에 미리 올릴걸 그랬어요.
lines.en: Oh, I should have posted it on the homepage board earlier.
lines.roman: A, hompeiji gesipane miri ollilgeol geuraesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Did you print the interview questions?
lines.learner: 프린터가 고장 났어요. 미리 뽑을걸 그랬어요.
lines.en: The printer broke. I should have printed them earlier.
lines.roman: Peurinteoga gojang nasseoyo. Miri ppobeulgeol geuraesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: It's fine. We can read them on a phone screen.
lines.learner: 네, 그래도 녹음기는 잘 켜져서 다행이에요.
lines.en: Yes, at least the recorder turns on fine. What a relief.
lines.roman: Ne, geuraedo nogeumgineun jal kyeojyeoseo dahaengieyo.

lines.beaver_en: What was today's interview topic again?
lines.en: A robot invention. It airs next month.

lines.beaver_en: Do you think robots will be used in broadcasting too?
lines.learner: 네. 요즘은 기계가 방송 영상도 찍어요.
lines.en: Yes. These days machines even film broadcast videos.
lines.roman: Ne. Yojeumeun gigyega bangsong yeongsangdo jjigeoyo.

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 이제 준비 끝! 촬영 시작해요.
lines.beaver_en: Right. We're all set! Let's start filming.
lines.beaver_roman: Majayo. Ije junbi kkeut! Chwaryeong sijakaeyo.
lines.en: Okay, I'll download the video after we finish.
